```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(leaflet)
library(lubridate)
```

## 1. Spatial mapping

```{r}
substations <- tibble(
  region = c("Attica", "Central Macedonia", "Crete", "Thessaly", "Peloponnese"),
  lat = c(37.9838, 40.6401, 35.2401, 39.6390, 37.5715),
  lon = c(23.7275, 22.9444, 24.8093, 22.4191, 22.3727),
  base_capacity_mw = c(1200, 800, 300, 400, 350)
)
```

## 2. Interactive map using leaflet

```{r}
leaflet(substations) %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~paste("<b>Region:</b>", region, "<br><b>Capacity:</b>", base_capacity_mw, "MW"),
    radius = ~base_capacity_mw / 100,
    color = "darkorange",
    fillOpacity = 0.7
  )
```

## 3. Data Engineering & EDA

```{r}
set.seed(42)
dates <- seq(ymd("2025-01-01"), ymd("2025-12-31"), by = "day")

load_data <- expand_grid(date = dates, region = substations$region) |>
  left_join(substations, by = "region") |>
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    is_weekend = ifelse(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 1, 0),
    
    temp_c = 15 + 12 * sin(pi * (month - 4) / 6) + rnorm(n(), 0, 3),
    
    temp_effect = ifelse(temp_c > 25, (temp_c - 25) * 15, 
                  ifelse(temp_c < 10, (10 - temp_c) * 10, 0)),
    
    actual_load_mw = base_capacity_mw * 0.6 + temp_effect - (is_weekend * 50) + rnorm(n(), 0, 20)
  )
```

## For Attica and Crete Region

```{r}
load_data |> 
  filter(region == "Attica") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = actual_load_mw)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "darkred", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Attica Region: Daily Energy Load Profile", x = "Date", y = "Load (MW)") +
  theme_minimal()

load_data |> 
  filter(region == "Crete") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = actual_load_mw)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "darkred", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Crete Region: Daily Energy Load Profile", x = "Date", y = "Load (MW)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 4. Predictive modeling with 'tidymodels'

```{r}
# Step 1: Dataset split
data_split <- initial_split(load_data, prop = 0.80)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# Step 2: Preprocessing
preprocessed <- recipe(actual_load_mw ~ temp_c + month + is_weekend + base_capacity_mw, data = train_data) %>% 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Step 3: Model Specification
linear_spec <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm")

# Step 4: The Workflow
load_workflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(preprocessed) %>% 
  add_model(linear_spec)

# Step 5: Train the model
trained_model <- load_workflow %>% 
  fit(data = train_data)

tidy(trained_model)
```

## 5. Evaluation on unseen data

```{r}
test_results <- test_data %>% 
  bind_cols(predict(trained_model, new_data = test_data))

# RMSE and R-Squared
metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)
metrics(test_results, truth = actual_load_mw, estimate = .pred)

# Plot Actual vs. Predicted values
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = actual_load_mw, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_abline(lty = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Model Accuracy: Actual vs Predicted Load", x = "Actual Load (MW)", y = "Predicted Load (MW)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
